name: 14-hydroxymorphine
summary: 14-Hydroxymorphine is a semi-synthetic opioid, chemical compound closely related to alkaloid morphine, characterized by an additional hydroxyl group at the 14th position. It is a potential precursor or metabolite of other potent opioids, such as oxymorphone (which is 14-hydroxydihydromorphinone).

pharmacology.text: 14-hydroxymorphine acts primarily as a μ-opioid receptor (MOR) agonist.

uses.en: It is studied as a research chemical and a possible step in making other opioids. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它作為研究用化學品及製造其他鴉片類藥物的可能中間體而受到研究，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它作为研究用化学品及制造其他鸦片类药物的可能中间体而受到研究，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing and kill. They also cause dependence, with a hard withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。同類的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量可能使呼吸停止而致命。這類藥物也會造成依賴，戒斷過程辛苦。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。同类的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量可能使呼吸停止而致命。这类药物也会造成依赖，戒断过程辛苦。

fact.en: An extra hydroxyl group at position 14 is the same change that, together with others, gives the strong painkillers oxymorphone and oxycodone.
fact.zh: 在14號位置多一個羥基，正是羥嗎啡酮與羥考酮這類強效止痛藥結構上的共同改變之一。
fact.zhHans: 在14号位置多一个羟基，正是羟吗啡酮与羟考酮这类强效止痛药结构上的共同改变之一。
